label: External cause of esse: Another being by which the thing's act of being is caused, mode unspecified
term: external cause of esse (q.3 a.4), mode of causing unspecified
definition: Another being by which the thing's act of being is caused, contrasted with essential principles causing their own subject's esse. The mode of causing is not fixed: the q.3 a.4 conclusion 'habeat esse causatum ab alio' does not name it, and the Lean declaration (another actual being that CausesIn at esse) does not encode it. The efficient sense is the separate CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6 (definition d8963cdd, #1633), which adds that the cause is an efficient cause of the esse. This source notion is not defined as ongoing conservation, withdrawal power, or arbitrary modal power; mapping those notions to the existing CausesIn relation requires a separate interpretation.
